sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Saving the Mole is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, mercenary. I've got a lot of work, so I'll be brief. TerraGroup sent a USEC task force after one of their employees. He was accused of leaking information and they wanted him removed. I don't know if they succeeded or not, which is why you need to investigate this. Check the TerraGroup complex in the city center, look for traces of both the squad and the employee. I used to work with him, so I want to know what happened in the end. He almost always carried a drive with his important data on it, so if you find it, bring it to me."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Access the lab scientist's office on Ground Zero
  - (Optional) Locate the USEC group at the parking lot of the TerraGroup complex
  - (Optional) Locate the lab scientist in the TerraGroup complex
- Locate and obtain the scientist's hard drive
- Hand over the hard drive

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,800 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.01
- 15,000 Roubles
  - 15,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 17,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Tube of Poxeram cold welding
- 2× Metal spare parts
"They killed him? Well, that's sad, but expected. TerraGroup was desperate to cover their tracks. You've done a good job. And thanks for the data drive."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| TerraGroup science office key | 1 | Required | N/A | Unlocks office no. 4 in the TerraGroup building. |
| TerraGroup scientist's hard drive | 1 | Required | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
In this quest you first have to locate the lab scientist in the main building of the TerraGroup building complex. He can be found in a hallway behind the big TerraGroup sign in the entrance hall, buried under rubble. Inside the body, a TerraGroup science office key can be found which unlocks office no. 4 on the second floor. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid, but can be taken by other players.

Afterwards you have to find a hard drive in the scientist's office (no. 4) on the second floor. The office can be unlocked with the TerraGroup science office key.

Once you are inside the office, the hard drive can be found at the only desk with turned on screens. It can be located on the desk top, or in the right side shelf.
